title: Flatness modulo all powers of an ideal implies flatness (Noetherian case)
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a ring map of commutative rings, $I\subseteq R$ an ideal and $M$ an $S$-module (an $R$-module via $\varphi$). Assume (1) $R$ is a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]; (2) $S$ is a Noetherian ring; (3) $M$ is a finitely generated $S$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; (4) for every $n\ge1$ the module $M/I^nM$ is flat over $R/I^n$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then for every prime $\mathfrak q\subseteq S$ containing $IS$ (the ideal of $S$ generated by $\varphi(I)$) the localization $M_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a flat $R$-module. In particular, if $S$ is a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_S$ and $IS\subseteq\mathfrak m_S$, then $M$ is a flat $R$-module.

proof.text: For every ideal J of R, let x be in the kernel of M tensor_R J -> M. For k >= 1, apply Module.Flat.lTensor_subtype_injective_of_smul_eq_zero to the image of J -> R/I^k, using the assumed flatness of M/I^k M. Its inclusion in R/I^k stays injective after tensoring with M. The image of x there is zero because its image in M tensor_R R is zero. Right exactness for J intersection I^k -> J -> image(J -> R/I^k) puts x in the image of M tensor_R (J intersection I^k).

Apply Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul to J inside R, obtaining c. For n > 0 use k = n+c, so k >= 1 and J intersection I^k is contained in I^n J. Factor its tensor inclusion through I^n J; range_lTensor_smul_top_subtype_le shows x lies in I^n(M tensor_R J). For n=0 the claim is automatic.

J is finite over R by Noetherianity. Tensor base-change cancellation makes M tensor_R J finite over S. Move scalars across the tensor product and use Ideal.map_pow to transfer the preceding membership to every power of IS. Mathlib Ideal.mem_iInf_smul_pow_eq_bot_iff, the elementwise Artin-Rees intersection theorem, gives r in IS with r*x=x. Thus (1-r)*x=0. If IS is contained in q then 1-r is outside q, since otherwise 1 belongs to q.

Use IsLocalizedModule.rTensor for M -> M_q. Naturality with J -> R is proved on pure tensors. IsLocalizedModule.injective_of_map_zero reduces injectivity of M_q tensor_R J -> M_q tensor_R R to elements coming from M tensor_R J. If the localized image of x is zero, the localization kernel criterion gives s outside q killing its unlocalized image. Apply the previous steps to s*x; a further factor 1-r outside q kills s*x. Therefore x has zero localized image. Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_injective′ gives flatness of M_q over R.

For S local, take its maximal ideal q. Elements in q.primeCompl are units, so the identity linear map of M satisfies IsLocalizedModule q.primeCompl. The canonical IsLocalizedModule.iso is an S-linear equivalence between M_q and M. Restrict it to R and apply Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv to the previously proved flatness of M_q.
